## Objective

A proposal has one canonical byte form and one SHA-256, stable across key order and Unicode forms.

## Scope

As stated in the objective and acceptance criteria; nothing beyond them.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Equal payloads hash equally regardless of key order
- [ ] any change to payload, dependencies or class changes the hash
- [ ] a batch digest depends on order
- [ ] non-JSON values are rejected
- [ ] The canonical profile is documented and every value outside it is rejected, not coerced
- [ ] received JSON with duplicate keys, floats or invalid encoding is rejected at the parsing boundary
- [ ] keys that collide after normalisation are rejected before the object is built
- [ ] golden vectors pin the profile to its version

## Test requirements

Unit and property-style tests.

## Deliverables

Code or configuration, tests, and updated documentation for this ticket.

## Definition of done

Implementation exists; relevant automated tests pass; acceptance criteria are met; security requirements are met; documentation is updated; review is complete (PD-004); evidence is linked; no critical defect is open; integration checks pass. Deployment tickets distinguish code complete, tested, deployment ready, deployed and production verified.
